name: Pilotariak
description: Public read-only agent interface for pilotariak.com, an open-source software organisation for the Basque pelota sport community. Exposes project information, competition data, player profiles and API documentation over HTTP+JSON. No authentication required. No write operations.

skills.name: Project information
skills.description: Get details about Pilotariak open-source projects: Frontis (GraphQL API gateway), Kancha (iOS & Android mobile app), Xilo (Slack bot), and Azkena (MCP server). Includes descriptions, GitHub links, and feature overviews.
examples: Tell me about the Frontis GraphQL API
Is there a mobile app for Basque pelota?

skills.name: MCP server — Azkena
skills.description: Access Basque pelota data (competitions, results, players, frontons) through the Azkena Model Context Protocol server at https://pilotariak.com/azkena. Exposes MCP tools and resources so AI agents can query the platform directly.
examples: What MCP tools does Pilotariak expose?
How do I connect to the Azkena MCP server?

skills.name: GraphQL API — Frontis
skills.description: Query the Frontis GraphQL gateway, which unifies five data domains (competitions, clubs, results, categories, disciplines) into a single federated API endpoint for Basque pelota data.
examples: How do I fetch competition results from Frontis?

skills.name: Basque pelota sport context
skills.description: Get background information about Basque pelota (pelote basque): disciplines (Cesta Punta, Grand Chistera, Main Nue, Paleta, Xare, Rebot), statistics (240+ competitions/year, 1 800 players, 120 frontons), and community context.
examples: What disciplines does Basque pelota have?
How many players are registered in the Pilotariak platform?
